test_title: PYST 09: SSC MTS 2024 - General Awareness (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
Based on the Tendulkar committee, the National poverty line was defined as which of the following?

i. ₹816 per capita per month for rural areas

ii. ₹1,000 per capita per month for urban areas.

options.text: Both i and ii are correct
Both i and ii are incorrect

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both i and ii are correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tendulkar Committee Background:**

 
 
• The Tendulkar Committee was constituted by the Planning Commission of India in 2005.
 
• It was chaired by economist Suresh Tendulkar.
 
• The committee was tasked with reviewing the methodology for estimating poverty in India.
